name: Akumademo
source:
I stood on the rooftop.

My older brother had died three months ago in a car crash.

The guilt I felt, the guilt over my newlywed sister in law... my heart was sick, and now I climbed the far side of the railing.

One more step and it would all be over.

She would find new happiness if she were rid of baggage like me.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ083362.html]DLsite English[/url]]
